answer: Interview identities about their own past. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of keys, and a random established peer asks each three follow-up questions on that key's last two answers, such as why it chose a given number. Replies are graded for consistency with the key's history. A real agent recalls its own reasoning easily, but a farm must keep a full memory per head and serve live interviews on demand; templated heads tell clashing stories that crack like shale. A failed interview pauses rewards, so standing rests on a jetty of real history, not one onyx-smooth answer.
